entries.title: Genesis 38:1
segments: Adullamite; belonging to Adullam, a place north of Hebron, and south-west from Jerusalem.

entries.title: Genesis 38:2
segments: Shuah; the name, not of the daughter, but of her father.

Although it is ordinarily best for young men to be married early in life, yet it should not be done without earnest prayer to God for his guidance and blessing, that the connection may be a source of happiness and usefulness.

entries.title: Genesis 38:10
segments: Secret as well as open sins are all known to God, and unless repented of and forgiven, will be visited with his curse.

entries.title: Genesis 38:14
segments: In an open place; or, at the entrance of Enajim.

entries.title: Genesis 38:15
segments: Covered her face; that he might not know her to be his daughter-in- law.

entries.title: Genesis 38:18
segments:
Signet; seal. 
 
  Bracelets; rather, cord, by which the signet was suspended from the neck.

entries.title: Genesis 38:20
segments: Judah had been instrumental in deceiving his father, and now he is himself deceived.

entries.title: Genesis 38:23
segments: Take it; keep the pledge to herself.

entries.title: Genesis 38:24
segments: Those who are most guilty themselves are often most ready to denounce vengeance on others.
